note:
Recipe ingredient term -> a term build/resolve.py can find. Seeded from a corpus by build/seed_ingredient_map.py; NOTHING here takes effect until an entry carries `signed_off_by`, which build/ingest.py is the only reader of.

Kept separate from data/resolution-store.json on purpose. That file pins what a DINER means by a word, 53 entries carrying long arguments about allergen scope. This one records what a RECIPE WRITER means, runs to hundreds of mostly-mechanical entries, and wants a different review burden. Merging them would bury the reasoned decisions in the routine ones.
